headline: From concept
to creation.
copy.sub: Extensions, renovations and new builds across Sompting and Sussex. Father and son, over 20 years in the trade, and free no-obligation quotes.
copy.alt: A contemporary white-rendered new build with cedar cladding and a landscaped garden
copy.about_alt: A rear extension with black steel-framed glazing, built by Garrard Construction
copy.lede: Garrard Construction Ltd was founded in 2014 by Ryan Garrard and his dad Robert, with over 20 years in the trade between them. They take on everything from a skirting board to a brand-new house, and every job is finished to the same standard.
copy.services_intro: Home renovation to new build properties.

services.title: Extensions
services.blurb: Single and double storey extensions, including steel-framed glazing and open-plan kitchens.
services.intro: More room, more light, built to last.

services.title: New builds and renovations
services.blurb: New build homes and whole-house renovations, from groundwork to the last coat of paint.
services.intro: One team from concept to creation.

services.title: Roofing
services.blurb: New roofs, trusses, flat roofs, eaves and rotten timber replaced.
services.intro: Roofs built and repaired properly, so the weather stays out.

services.title: Carpentry and joinery
services.blurb: Oak staircases, walk-in wardrobes, shelving, skirting and architrave.
services.intro: Nailing every job, because nobody likes a screw up.

services.title: Bathrooms, plumbing and electrics
services.blurb: Bathrooms fitted with tiling and lit niches, plus plumbing, heating and electrical work.
services.intro: The trades under one roof, so you are not chasing three firms.

services.title: Decking, patios and outdoor
services.blurb: Decking, steps, patios, ramps and rendering outside the house.
services.intro: Outside space you will actually use.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: Walls up, trusses on, materials craned in and stacked ready.

steps.title: Roofed
steps.text: The roof boarded and insulated before the weather can get in.

steps.title: Built
steps.text: Rendered, clad and glazed, with patios and lawns laid outside.

steps.title: Finished inside
steps.text: Oak floors, glass balustrades and big glazing letting the light in.

steps.title: Ready to move in
steps.text: Kitchen fitted, lights on, keys handed over.

reviews: Thanks Ryan - love my patio looks so good! Really friendly guy and a really skilled worker would 100% recommend to anyone. Made my summer garden parties much more fun!

Ryan and his team were absolutely brilliant. I needed extensive replacement of rotten eaves, a flat roof and a ceiling. All of this was done to a high standard. They were always punctual, considerate and tidy and worked hard to get the job done to an excellent standard.

Ryan responded promptly with a visit and a very fair quote. Planning the job in, he was easy and clear to communicate with; turned up as promised, worked efficiently and did a good job; we are very pleased.
Such lovely people father and son. Prompt, efficient and super polite. What a pleasure. Thankyou both.

faqs: We are based in Sompting and work across Sussex, including Lancing, Worthing, Shoreham-by-Sea and Steyning.
Do you take on small jobs?
Yes. We have a no job too small attitude, from skirting and shelving to full new builds.
Do you do plumbing and electrics too?
Yes. Plumbing and heating, carpentry and electrical work are all covered.
Ryan and Robert Garrard, father and son, who run the business.
